mapper.select: SELECT CART_NUM , B.BOOK_NUM , BOOK_PRICE , CART_CNT , CART_DATE , I.UPLOAD_FILE_NAME , B.BOOK_TITLE , MEM_EMAIL FROM SHOP_CART C, SHOP_BOOK B, BOOK_IMG I WHERE C.BOOK_NUM = B.BOOK_NUM AND B.BOOK_NUM = I.BOOK_NUM AND I.IS_MAIN = 'Y' AND C.MEM_EMAIL = #{memEmail} ORDER BY CART_NUM DESC;
